verdict.rationale: Clara documents a comprehensive programmatic API that controls cards, transactions, users and invoices, with credentials self-managed from the dashboard and an OpenAPI 3.1 schema for typed clients. It also offers a sandbox for end-to-end integration testing without real financial operations, so it can be driven headlessly for automation without the UI. missing for 10: no official CLI or documented CI/pipeline usage, no explicit non-interactive/service-account auth flow details, no independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.
